mapper.sql: model_version, coefficients, intercept, sample_count, active, trained_at
mapper.select: select from tag_ranking_model where active = 1 order by trained_at desc limit 1
mapper.update: update tag_ranking_model set active = 0 where active = 1
mapper.insert: insert into tag_ranking_model (model_version, coefficients, intercept, sample_count, active, trained_at) values (#{modelVersion}, #{coefficients}, #{intercept}, #{sampleCount}, #{active}, now()) on duplicate key update coefficients = values(coefficients), intercept = values(intercept), sample_count = values(sample_count), active = values(active), trained_at = now()
